// diagnostic E0119

Jet.UnknownType

`Bogus` isn't a known effect

What

`Bogus` isn't a known effect

Why

An effect list names compiler-known effects like `Net`, `FS`, `IO`, `DB`, or `Time`

Fix

Use one of the known effect names, or remove it from the list

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnknownType: Tests/UI/any_names_no_type.stderr.

Error: Jet.UnknownType: There's no type called `Any`
  --> Tests/UI/any_names_no_type.jet:3:17
    |
  3 | size: fn(value: Any) -> Int { 1 }
    |                 ^^^
 Why: Jet has no catch-all type, since every value has one type the compiler knows
 Fix: Use an enum for a closed set of types, a trait for an open set, or `reflect.of(value)` to inspect any value
